name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Implementation Manager | Project Management, Workflow Configuration & Go-Live Support
summary: Implementation manager who acts as both project manager and customer point of contact, from workflow assessment through configuration, training, and go-live support. At Wix I launched 25+ clients a month with up to ~25 in flight, at 110% of implementation targets. I break complex systems down for non-technical stakeholders, analyze adoption data to drive action, and build the documentation and processes that shorten time to value.

experience.title: Implementation Lead — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Lead end-to-end implementations as project manager and client point of contact, assessing workflows, translating requirements into system configuration, and training owners and staff.
Configure integrations and credentials (OAuth, API keys, webhooks) in Zapier, Make, and n8n, and validate data imports into Salesforce, HubSpot, and GoHighLevel before go-live.
Build performance dashboards and regular reporting that turn funnel and pipeline data into recommendations for business owners.
Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable, keeping project records auditable across concurrent engagements.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and trained 15-20 reseller partners across health, home services, and retail, including agencies focused on healthcare clients, retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Analyzed partner utilization metrics to spot adoption gaps early and recommend interventions that reduced churn.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors across teams.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Implemented and launched 25+ clients per month with up to ~25 concurrent onboardings, holding 110% of implementation targets and delivering launches on schedule.
Led multiple onboarding teams of up to 30 specialists, running weekly training sessions, workshops for new initiatives, and 1:1 coaching.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to the implementation team to execute.
Held workshops for client teams and built relationships with C-suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
